These qualities will be utilized routinely to devise and implement a variety of in vivo and in vitro model systems. These models will be used to build an in-depth understanding of biological datasets surrounding [Company name masked] drug targets and drug candidates. Senior Scientists will contribute both intellectually and experimentally as part of a multidisciplinary team, routinely collating and presenting data in both internal and external forums.
cond_0454.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in immunology or a closely related field with >2 years of relevant industry experience
Intellectual and experimental proficiency in various aspects of immunology gained through demonstrated research experience documented in presentations and publications

Expertise in common immunological experimental techniques including isolation and culture of primary immune cells and tissues (mouse and human), multi-color flow cytometry, ELISA (or equivalent method), qPCR, western blot, and transfection methods
Ability to identify, design, conduct, and interpret critical experiments necessary to advance programs
Ability to focus and deliver on time-sensitive objectives
Preferred Requirements
Basic awareness of adjacent drug discovery activities (bioinformatics, biomarkers, screening) to facilitate cross-functional interactions and fully inform project goals
Strong communication skills, capable of presenting to diverse audiences and summarizing information

Senior Scientists at [Company name masked] work in a highly collaborative environment with colleagues across the organization. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of immunological data and how it connects to drug development decisions.
cond_0508.responsibilities: The successful applicant will be expected to lead elements of [Company name masked]'s programs providing in-depth knowledge, technical expertise, and insights necessary to advance drug development programs. These qualities will be utilized routinely to devise and implement a variety of in vivo and in vitro model systems. These models will be used to build an in-depth understanding of biological datasets surrounding [Company name masked] drug targets and drug candidates. Senior Scientists will contribute both intellectually and experimentally as part of a multidisciplinary team, routinely collating and presenting data in both internal and external forums.
cond_0508.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in immunology or a closely related field with >2 years of relevant industry experience
Intellectual and experimental proficiency in various aspects of immunology gained through demonstrated research experience documented in presentations and publications
Practical experience using in vitro and in vivo tumor, autoimmune, and/or inflammation models
Expertise in common immunological experimental techniques including isolation and culture of primary immune cells and tissues (mouse and human), multi-color flow cytometry, ELISA (or equivalent method), qPCR, western blot, and transfection methods
Ability to identify, design, conduct, and interpret critical experiments necessary to advance programs
Ability to focus and deliver on time-sensitive objectives
Preferred Requirements
Basic awareness of adjacent drug discovery activities (bioinformatics, biomarkers, screening) to facilitate cross-functional interactions and fully inform project goals
Strong communication skills, capable of presenting to diverse audiences and summarizing information
Experience authoring technical internal and external documents such as posters, manuscripts, IND reports, and investigator brochures
